controls-plan.json.sampling: none; perf stat enabled only in timed interval
controls-plan.json.eligibility: flag p99>10ms or mean fdatasync>1ms; highest eligible throughput; all raw retained

normal-plan.json.perf: cpu-clock:u 499Hz DWARF4096; timed interval only; output Linux memfd
normal-plan.json.scopes: inclusive, 1/64 samples; diagnostic, not throughput qualification

complete-plan.json.perf: cpu-clock:u 499Hz DWARF4096; timed interval only; output Linux memfd
complete-plan.json.scopes: inclusive, 1/64 samples; diagnostic, not throughput qualification

mirrors-plan.json.selection: highest eligible throughput with same-run p99; flag p99>10ms or mean fdatasync>1ms; preserve all; normal counters, detailed diagnostics off

plan.json.perf: cpu-clock:u 499Hz DWARF4096; timed interval only; output Linux memfd
plan.json.scopes: inclusive, 1/64 samples; diagnostic, not throughput qualification
